reason: Both satisfy every hard requirement, but Response B gives more concrete, actionable guidance: it explicitly addresses snapshotting to a separate volume when the near-full disk itself constrains snapshot capacity, specifies concrete rollback steps (restore from snapshot, resume paused jobs only if safe, verify integrity on a scratch instance) rather than just escalation, and adds post-mitigation data-integrity/replica-consistency checks in FOLLOW UP that Response A omits.
